notes: μακροθυμήσας heads on *patiently* under rule 91's operational test, the corpus spending the patience word on μακροθυμ- (HEB.6.12 μακροθυμίας → *patience*) and *endured* being the supplied completion. The alternative head on *endured* is named in the unit note.
οὕτως stands alone on *thus*; no correlative καί accompanies it, so rule 100 is not in question.
